title: Machine manifest
description: Captured at every benchmark run (architecture.md section 2). Every probed field is a record carrying its status and the exact command that produced it, so any number in a result bundle can be reproduced by hand. A field that could not be read is UNAVAILABLE with a reason -- never omitted, never defaulted, never inferred from a spec sheet.

probeRecord.description: A single probed value. 'source' is the exact command, so the figure is reproducible; 'reason' is written for someone reading it months later who must decide whether the gap matters.

status.description: UNAVAILABLE is never a pass (ci.md section 4).

value.description: Absent or null when the status is UNAVAILABLE. Never a zero standing in for a missing measurement.

source.description: The command, file or document the value came from.

reason.description: Required in spirit whenever status is UNAVAILABLE.

status.description: Present only when no probe set exists for this host.

smoke_test.description: Present only when one platform's probe set was forced on another. Every value is then meaningless and the manifest must never be archived.

role.description: An unrecognised machine defaults to 'development', because defaulting the other way would let an unknown box quietly produce evidence.

checked.description: False on a development machine, where the hardware differs by design and the comparison would be noise.

mismatches.description: What the plan claims versus what the device reports. Recorded, never resolved by overwriting the measured value.

evidence_eligible.description: Whether results from this machine may be archived as evidence. False on a development machine and on any forced-host smoke run.

contract.description: Not measured: fixed by architecture.md section 2.

fields.description: Hardware and OS probes. Keys vary by host.

unavailable.description: Dotted paths of every field that could not be read.
